title: The Hollow Crown
tagline: Three stolen heart-stones, one royal tinker, and a narrator with opinions.
description: A fairy-tale point-and-click adventure in painted storybook dioramas. The Crown of Wrenfold woke up hollow: its Ember, Bloom and Tide stones have been stolen. As the Queen's tinker, explore ten interconnected scenes across three chapters — the village and castle, the Whispering Woods, and the sea cliffs — solving fair, cluable inventory and dialog puzzles with a smart one-click interface, a world map, a three-tier hint system and no dead ends. Humorous 'deaths' rewind instantly; good deeds are counted but never required.
controls: Click to walk and act (smart cursor) · Right-click or long-press to look · Click an item, then a target to use it (or another item to combine) · Tab reveals hotspots · H hint · M map · Esc menu · Space/Enter advances text
fablePass: Hand-keyed character animation: walk/run cycles, talk gestures, reach/pick-up, idle fidgets (actors.js procedural rig is the placeholder)
Lip-sync / mouth shapes for NPCs and Grumbleroot's bark face
Music: a theme per chapter, leitmotifs for Corvin and the Crown's song, coronation finale
Ambient soundscapes per scene (river, sea, birds, tavern choir) and voiced narrator
Cutscene choreography: Corvin swooping to the mirror, the lighthouse beam reveal, the epilogue coronation
